description_en: Retrieves the details of one or more categories in a specified workspace
description_zh: 获取指定业务空间下一个或多个类目的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun bailian list-category --workspace-id llm-3shx2gu255oqxxxx --category-type UNSTRUCTURED --api-version 2023-12-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCategory

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html. The bailian 2023-12-29 API version does not provide an API operation for listing workspaces. Obtain the workspace ID from the Model Studio console before calling this operation

parameters.help_en:
The number of categories per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 200. Valid values: 1 to 200.

Default value:
If the value is not set or is less than 1, the default value is 20. If the value is greater than 200, the default value is 200
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页类目数量。最大值为 200。取值范围[1-200]

默认值：
当不设置值或设置的值小于 1 时，默认值为20。当设置的值大于 200 时，默认值为 200
